# Timewheel

> Timewheel (Timewheel Internet Pvt. Ltd.) is a Nagpur-based digital partner that builds and grows businesses online: websites, web apps, SEO, digital marketing, ads and social, on self-hosted systems you own rather than rented SaaS platforms.

Based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Serving clients across India and worldwide.
Contact: hello@timewheel.co.in

## Services
- [Digital Marketing Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/digital-marketing-nagpur): SEO, social media, Google Ads, content and websites for Nagpur businesses.
- [SEO Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/seo-company-in-nagpur): Local SEO, technical SEO, content and AI-search (AEO) visibility, with a free instant audit.
- [Web Development Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/web-development-company-in-nagpur): Websites and web applications.
- [Website Design](https://timewheel.co.in/website-design-company-in-nagpur): Conversion-focused website design.
- [Web App Development](https://timewheel.co.in/web-app-development-company-in-nagpur): Custom web applications.
- [Restaurant Marketing](https://timewheel.co.in/restaurant-marketing): Marketing for restaurants and cafes.
- [Digital Marketing](https://timewheel.co.in/digital-marketing): Full-service digital marketing.
- [Performance Marketing Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/performance-marketing-company-in-nagpur): ROI-focused paid ads, SEO, social and content.
- [Social Media Marketing Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/social-media-marketing-company-in-nagpur): Social media strategy, content and management.
- [Shopify Development Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/shopify-development-company-in-nagpur): Shopify store design, build and optimisation.
- [AI Marketing Automation Company in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/ai-marketing-automation-company-in-nagpur): AI-driven marketing automation.
- [AI Automation Agency in Nagpur](https://timewheel.co.in/ai-automation-agency-in-nagpur): AI workflow and business-process automation.

## Products
- [Book A Sloth](https://timewheel.co.in/products/book-a-sloth): An India-first appointment booking and scheduling platform Timewheel designed and built. 24/7 booking pages, UPI and Razorpay payments, two-way Google Calendar sync, WhatsApp and email reminders, GST invoicing, and a business dashboard. Live at https://bookasloth.com.
- [Alluminaty](https://timewheel.co.in/products/alluminaty): A Timewheel product. See the page for details.
